text: Remote work limit: employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week. The policy states, "Remote work is allowed only for up to two days per week and must be pre-approved by the manager."
Annual leave: employees receive 20 paid leave days per year. The policy states, "Employees are entitled to 20 annual leave days and may carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next year."

Travel meals cap: employees may claim up to INR 1200 per day for meals while traveling. The rule states, "Meal reimbursement is capped at INR 1200 per day and all claims must include a valid receipt."
VPN security: MFA is required for all VPN access. The policy states, "Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for VPN access."
Expense policy: receipts are required for expenses above INR 2000. The policy states, "Any expense above INR 2000 must be accompanied by a receipt."
Working hours: employees are required to work 9 hours per day from Monday to Friday. The guidance says, "The standard working schedule is 9 hours per day, Monday through Friday."
